label: alanine arylamidase activity
definition: A phenotype in which a microorganism exhibits alanine arylamidase/alanyl aminopeptidase activity, releasing N-terminal residues from peptide, amide, or arylamide substrates with preference for alanine.
observations: Follow-up from the physiology diagnostic-enzyme gap sweep; absent from METPO and TraitMech after an alanine arylamidase duplicate review covering ignored and hidden files.
